summary:
Static WCAG 2.2 A/AA (+cheap AAA) audit of the main app shell and bundle UI. I read every React component in bundle.pretty.js (lines ~96200-113377, 632 JSX element sites, zustand store, map helpers), both lazy chunks, index.html (all 760 lines, 8 inline scripts), site-nav.js/css, manifest, sw.js and the app CSS. I computed contrast for 234 inline text styles (method reproduces Lighthouse/axe numbers: #777=4.39, #555=2.64, #8b6914=4.00, #666=3.54), simulated colour-vision deficiencies for the map palette, and dry-ran 18 candidate bundle string patches (each FIND matches exactly once on the deployed bundle; patched copy passes node --check). No browser/AT was used (rules), so runtime claims are labelled 'from code' with verification steps.

Headline: Lighthouse's a11y 90 is an automated subset on one screen state. By code, of 55 WCAG 2.2 A+AA criteria 23 fail (13 Level A, 10 AA), 10 partial, 12 pass, 10 N/A; I grade accessibility D desktop / D mobile (not C+/C). The app has ZERO aria-* / role / aria-live / landmarks / h1 (Lighthouse bypass audit confirms: no skip link, heading or landmark); all 75 button sites are glyph/emoji named; 17 functional controls are click-only div/canvas (including the Choose-Your-Experience cards, Skip intro, unit selection on the map, search results, timeline markers, mobile scrubber); the map is a canvas with no keyboard or text alternative; a global window keydown handler fires bare S/F/L/M/H/B/?/1/2/3/+/-/Space/Arrows (fails 2.1.4, ignores Ctrl/Alt, collides with Mapbox's own keyboard handler and with a second timeline onKeyDown that double-fires); 13 overlays have no dialog semantics/focus management and Esc misses 12+ of them plus the pinned unit panel; union/confederate colours have identical luminance (1.02:1, achromat dE 0.4) and 11 dispositions are 3.5px colour-only dots; 62/234 text styles fail 4.5:1; 133/268 font-size literals are <12px (min 7px); the mobile layout renders the desktop timeline/legend/minimap/panels underneath itself (root cause of C1/C2).

Corrections to the earlier audit (verified in code): the index.html aria-label patch script is inert (skips any button with a title); toasts DO auto-dismiss (4.5s) so the WCAG issue is the opposite (2.2.1, no live region); hover popup fF and the H heatmap shortcut are dead code; share/bookmark URLs (?t=&u=&z=&ll=) are written but never read; desktop shows two different dates at once (toolbar correct, clock chip +2 days); three tick->clock formulas exist.

The report (34 findings, ~160 KB) contains: full control/dialog/keyboard/timer inventories with line refs, computed contrast/CVD/target/type tables, a criterion-by-criterion WCAG 2.2 table with evidence and fix IDs, design tokens and an A+ release gate, a full design for a keyboard + screen-reader map experience (semantic skeleton, keyboard model, unit-cursor algorithm, Data View table, situation summary, chronology transcript, announcement policy, dialog primitive), a Tier-0 bridge (index.html + CSS shim + 18 validated bundle patches with a safe re-hash pipeline) that can lift Lighthouse a11y to ~100 in 2-3 days without source, phased roadmap (~50 dev-days), and a test plan (Playwright+axe state matrix code, pa11y-ci, LHCI, jsx-a11y lint, token/palette/cursor unit tests, NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver/TalkBack scripts, forced-colors/zoom/text-spacing/CVD checks, 15 core AT tasks).

findings.title: Tier-0 shell + CSS shim: landmarks, skip link, single h1, two-tone focus ring, contrast overrides, 12px font floor, reduced-motion, forced-colors, coarse-pointer target minimum
findings.evidence: Lighthouse bypass audit (lh_desktop.json/lh_mobile.json): 'No valid skip link found / Page does not have a heading / Page does not have a landmark region'. index.html:716 <div id=root>, :285 <div id=extra-features>; 3 pre-mount h1 (:744 splash, :718 seo-content, :753 noscript) and none after React mounts. 62/234 inline text styles fail 4.5:1; 133/268 fontSize literals <12px; inline outline:'none' at bundle.pretty.js:98996, :101356, :112385; site-nav.css:43-47 and :110 remove outlines; no forced-colors CSS anywhere; assets/index-B4G7Z_2G.css is Mapbox-only.
findings.root_cause: Inline-style React app with no global CSS layer; index.html is the only place editable without source.
findings.fix: index.html: add skip links (#root, #gt-timeline), one sr-only h1, <main id=root tabindex=-1 aria-label>, <nav id=extra-features aria-label>, demote #seo-content h1 to h2 and splash h1 to p, meta color-scheme=dark, window.__gtbgReduceMotion flag script. New a11y-shim.css after site-nav.css: .gt-sr-only/.gt-skip; :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff!important;outline-offset:2px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #000!important}; attribute-selector colour overrides matching React's serialised inline colours ([style*=' color: rgb(85, 85, 85)'],[style^='color: ...'] etc.) mapping #444/#555->#8f8fa3, #666->#9a9aab, #777->#a8a8b8, #8b6914(text)->#b8963c, #3a6bc4(text)->#7fa8ff, #cc4444->#f07a7a, #6d7a8a->#9aa6b6 (all >=4.96:1 on every panel bg, computed); font-size 7-11px -> 12px !important; @media(pointer:coarse){#root button,#extra-features a,button{min 44px}}; reduced-motion block; forced-colors block (real borders, Highlight focus, canvas forced-color-adjust:none). Delete the inert label-patch script (index.html:398-440). Screenshot-review at 1440/1280/768/375 for the font floor.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse a11y >=97 on the loaded state (both form factors; the live color-contrast and bypass findings vanish; label needs app-a11y-02); document.querySelectorAll('h1').length===1; first Tab focuses 'Skip to the battle map' and Enter moves focus to #root; emulateMedia forcedColors:active -> every button has border-top-width>0; reducedMotion:reduce -> no CSS animation/transition >0.01ms; before/after screenshots show no clipped rows.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Lighthouse Accessibility 90 -> ~97-100 (loaded state); clears 2.4.1 (bypass) and 1.4.3 in loaded states; 2.4.7; forced-colors/reduced-motion baseline; type floor (Fit & finish).
findings.correction: Evidence real (index.html 716/285/718/744/753, site-nav.css 43-47/110/138, no forced-colors anywhere, contrast numbers reproduce, attribute selectors valid per LH snippets). Corrections: (a) acceptance 'LH a11y >= 97 after 01 alone' is wrong: only label (wt 10) and color-contrast (wt 7) of total 164 fail, so contrast-only fix = ~94; 100 needs 02-A; bypass is informative/score 1 (PASS title) and landmark-one-main score 1, so neither is a scored LH failure. (b) skip link href=#root bypasses nothing (toolbar is inside #root before the map); target must be the map container (needs id/tabIndex:-1 patch). (c) sr-only h1/skip links outside a landmark trip axe 'region'; wrap h1 in <header>. (d) retarget '#seo-content h1' CSS (index.html:160). (e) colour ladder makes #666/#777 replacements brighter than untouched #888 and narrows chip ON/OFF text. (f) outline:none is at 98995 not 98996, and 2 extra inline sites exist (111557, 111744). (g) effort S optimistic with QA of ~17 panels at 4 widths: M.

findings.title: Tier-0 bundle string patches (18 FIND strings validated on the deployed bundle) + safe re-hash pipeline
findings.evidence: Verified with tmp-app-a11y/bridge_patch_check.py: every FIND matches the expected count in bundle.min.js (1; 14/4/2 for regex/paired patches) and the patched copy passes node --check (+1,850 bytes). Targets: timeline slider min0/max100/step.01 unlabeled (bundle.pretty.js:112294-112303); wrapper onKeyDown + tabIndex:0 double-fires (:112216-112224); global handler ignores only INPUT (:112967); toolbar buttons name = letter/emoji (:113287-113298); layout cards div onClick (:102767,:102789); Skip intro div (:101569); 18 unnamed close glyphs; placeholder-only inputs; toast stack conditionally mounted (:99918); reduced-motion ignored (eO=3500 :101471, glow :96615, interpolation :97001).
findings.root_cause: No source for the deployed app (N1); prior sessions already patch the minified bundle. Assets are immutable, cache-first in sw.js and imported by name from both lazy chunks, so in-place edits would be served stale.
findings.fix: Idempotent script (kept in repo) that reads assets/index-Cg8FAMXN.js from the correctly-cased source tree, asserts each FIND count, applies: (A) slider -> type range, aria-label 'Battle time', aria-valuetext R(), min1 max M step1 value c onChange Number(); (B) wrapper -> id gt-timeline, tabIndex -1, role group, aria-label (removes double-fire); (C) global guard: return on defaultPrevented/Ctrl/Meta/Alt, INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT/contenteditable, Space/Enter on button/a/[role=button], arrows and + = - _ when .mapboxgl-canvas focused, everything but Esc while [role=dialog][aria-modal=true]; (D) Vs toolbar button: type button, aria-label=title, aria-pressed from active; (E) layout cards role=button tabIndex=0 aria-label onKeyDown Enter/Space onFocus/onBlur; (F) Skip intro div->button; (G) regex: 14+4 close glyph buttons aria-label 'Close'; (H) labels for filter range (+valuetext), search, ancestor and two monument inputs; (I) toast stack always mounted role=log aria-live=polite aria-label 'Battle events'; (J) reduced-motion flag for intro duration, glow pulse, sub-tick interpolation. Then write assets/index-<sha8>.js, rewrite the name in index.html (:55,:282), sw.js PRECACHE and both chunks' imports, bump CACHE_NAME, node --check, refuse to run on any count mismatch.
findings.acceptance_test: Script fails loudly if the bundle changes; Playwright: Tab+Enter on 'Select the desktop layout' enters the app; on the slider ArrowRight x3 -> tick+3 and aria-valuetext changes; Space on a focused forward button activates once and does not toggle playback; Ctrl+F does not open the filter panel; Lighthouse label audit passes; NVDA reads 'Battle time, slider, <clock>'.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Lighthouse label failure removed (with 01 -> ~100 loaded state); keyboard entry unblocked (2.1.1 on the two blocking screens); fixes double-fire keyboard bugs; partial 4.1.2/2.5.3/2.1.4.
findings.correction: 18 FIND counts, +1,850 B and node --check reproduce exactly. Corrections: (1) stale-chunk trap: pipeline rewrites HelpModal/BookmarkPanel chunk contents but keeps their filenames; /assets/* is immutable 1y (netlify.toml:23-25) and cache-first in sw.js, main loads them via import('./HelpModal-CFV9T0zH.js') (bundle.pretty.js:112469-70); returning visitors keep the old chunk which imports the old index-Cg8FAMXN.js whose top level re-runs createRoot(#root).render -> old app remounts (or 404). Rename/re-hash both chunks and patch the two import() specifiers and SW precache. (2) 02-I role=log implies aria-live=polite -> event chatter ON by default up to 16 ticks/s, contradicting the report's default-OFF policy; add aria-live:'off'. (3) collides with app-mobile apply_patches.py: on tmp-app-mobile/patched/assets/index-mHF1a.js G-close-mobile finds 3 (expects 4) and J1 finds 0 (expects 1) so the refuse-on-mismatch script aborts. (4) patch C dialog clause dead until 05. Effort M-L once merge + chunk rename counted.

findings.title: Entry flow: intro splash, layout chooser, onboarding - keyboard/SR operable, remembered, auto-detected, with a Text-view option
findings.evidence: Layout cards are div onClick with no tabIndex/role (bundle.pretty.js:102767,:102789) and say 'Best for mouse and keyboard' (:102778); 'Skip intro' is a #444 div (:101569,:101670); layout never persisted (only gtbg_onboarded, :113068); onboarding modal renders over the chooser (:113059-113070); 'Power User keyboard shortcuts' offered on touch (:111815); index.html:355-396 scrapes DOM text 'Choose Your Experience' to inject a banner.
findings.root_cause: One-off screens built as styled divs with no persistence layer; an injected script compensates.
findings.fix: Single EntryDialog (native <dialog>, aria-labelledby, focus to heading): three real radio/button cards - Map (desktop), Map (touch layout), Text view (screen readers/keyboard/low bandwidth); preselect via (pointer:coarse)+width; 'Remember my choice' default ON writes gtbg_prefs.view/layout so returning visitors skip it. Intro fast-forward optional: real Skip button + Esc, auto-skipped for prefers-reduced-motion/returning visitors, splash gets role=status 'Loading battle data'. Move the '20 more tools' banner copy into the dialog and delete the scraper. Onboarding tour = dialog with 'Step n of 5', Esc=skip, focus to step heading. Show shortcut tips only when a fine pointer exists.
findings.acceptance_test: Keyboard-only cold load: Tab reaches the 3 options, Enter selects, focus lands on the app heading; reload skips the chooser; reducedMotion -> no splash; NVDA announces dialog title and option names; axe 0 violations on all entry states.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Clears 2.1.1/4.1.2/2.4.3 on the entry path; Usability/learnability (mobile D+ -> B+ with H3); removes the ~15s repeat splash.
findings.correction: All cited lines verified (dO 102767/102789, copy 102778, gtbg_onboarded 113068, Power User 111815, banner scraper 355-396). depends_on omits 08 (Text-view card needs Data View) and 28 (fallback); ship chooser without the Text card first or add both dependencies.

findings.title: Replace every click-only div/canvas control with native semantics (16 functional sites + BookmarkPanel row + 7 backdrops)
findings.evidence: Inventory (inventory.py): click-only elements at bundle.pretty.js:97365 (map canvas), 98365 (story dots), 98855/98878 (search quick links/results), 99811 (minimap canvas), 100366 (tour dots), 100914 (monument markers), 101173/101249 (ancestor results/journey), 101569 (Skip intro), 101992 (Soldier's Eye rows), 102767/102789 (layout cards), 103177 (mobile scrubber, touch only), 110690 (walkthrough monument cards), 112272 (timeline markers), BookmarkPanel itemLeft; backdrops at :101135,:101963,:102373,:103368/:103371 and both chunks.
findings.root_cause: onClick on non-interactive elements; no shared list/row primitives; no lint.
findings.fix: Story dots -> <ol> of <button aria-current aria-label='Story 2 of 3: title'> with >=24/44px hit area; tour dots same; search rows -> combobox/listbox (see 14); ancestor results/journey -> <ul>/<ol> of <button>; Soldier's Eye rows -> <ul> of <button> with 'Opens Street View in Google Maps (new tab)' description; bookmark row -> <button> + separate Delete button aria-label='Delete bookmark {label}'; monument markers -> 22; walkthrough cards -> 25; layout cards/skip -> 03/02; mobile scrubber -> 07/24; timeline markers -> 07; map canvas -> 09; minimap -> 10. Backdrop click stays as convenience only. Enforce with eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (click-events-have-key-events, no-static-element-interactions, interactive-supports-focus) as errors.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright sweep: every visible element with computed cursor:pointer matches button,a[href],input,select,summary,[role=button|option|tab|radio],[tabindex] (empty exception list); Tab/Enter/Space operate every former click-only control; lint rules pass in CI.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 2.1.1, 4.1.2, 2.5.3 (Level A); Core function for keyboard/AT users.

findings.title: Dialog/overlay/panel system: real dialogs, focus move/trap/restore, inert background, Esc stack, z-index scale
findings.evidence: 13 modal-style overlays (splash, layout chooser, onboarding, help, bookmarks, ancestor, Soldier's Eye, OOB, roster, tools sheet, walkthrough, layers, distance) have no role=dialog/aria-modal, no trap/inert/restore; only 3 focus calls in the app (autoFocus :98819, .focus() :101016, bookmark autoFocus). Esc handler (:113033-113046) misses Layers, Distance, Legend, Story, Event card, Tools sheet, NPS tour, intro/chooser/onboarding and the pinned unit (MF :97909 Ee=c||f while Esc clears only selectedUnitId); Esc ignored in inputs (:112967); z-indexes 85-1000 and 999999 (index.html:185).
findings.root_cause: Each overlay hand-rolled; global Esc enumerates setters manually.
findings.fix: Dialog primitive on native <dialog> (showModal: top layer, focus trap, inert background, cancel event) and Panel primitive (role=region/aside aria-labelledby). Migrate modal: Entry, Onboarding, Help, Bookmarks, Follow Ancestor, Soldier's Eye, OOB, Tools sheet, Walkthrough, Settings; non-modal: Search, Filter, Legend, Unit, Story, Event log, Layers, Distance, NPS tour, Roster. Overlay stack: Esc pops top-most; in inputs first Esc clears, second closes; deselect clears selected AND pinned unit. Toolbar buttons get aria-expanded+aria-controls; keyboard-open moves focus to panel heading (tabindex -1) or [data-autofocus]; close restores focus to opener; panel DOM placed right after the map. Z-index scale tokens (map 1-9, panels 20, sheets 40, dialogs top layer, toasts 80). React 18.3 has no inert prop: use inert='' attribute or el.inert.
findings.acceptance_test: For each overlay (Playwright+axe): open by keyboard -> focus inside; 30 Tabs never leave a modal; Esc closes and document.activeElement===opener; background reports inert; aria-dialog-name passes; NVDA announces '<title>, dialog'.

findings.title: Single keyboard/shortcut module: 2.1.4 compliance, no Mapbox conflicts, correct Esc, truthful Help
findings.evidence: One window keydown (bundle.pretty.js:112966-113052) binds bare S/F/L/M/H/B/?/1/2/3/0/+/-/=/Space/Arrows; ignores only INPUT (:112967); no modifier guard (Ctrl+F/S/L/1 also fire); Space preventDefault on any target; conflicts with Mapbox keyboard handler on the focused canvas (Mapbox :89757-89811, canvas tabindex 0 :94008, keyboard:!0 :91902); duplicate wrapper handler (:112216); dead useGlobalKeyboard in HelpModal chunk; H toggles showCasualtyHeatmap that nothing reads (:9419,:9435,:112930); Help lists 'Esc dismiss panel/deselect' (partly false) and H heatmap; speed keys reach 16x while UI shows 8x (:112998 vs :112185).
findings.root_cause: Ad-hoc handlers per feature; no registry; Mapbox defaults left on.
findings.fix: shortcuts.ts registry {id, keys, scope app|map|timeline, handler, description} with one keydown listener on #root (focus scope) plus persistent prefs.shortcuts on/off (WCAG 2.1.4 mechanisms: turn off + focus scope). Guards: defaultPrevented, IME, Ctrl/Alt/Meta, event.repeat for toggles, targets input/textarea/select/[contenteditable]/[role=textbox|combobox|slider|spinbutton]/open modal dialog; Space/Enter never intercepted on button/a/[role=button]. Construct Mapbox with keyboard:false and implement pan/zoom/rotate on the map surface with documented keys (Shift+arrows pan, +/- zoom). Remove H until a heatmap exists; align speed range; generate Help and User Guide shortcut table from the registry; aria-keyshortcuts on operated buttons.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: with the map focused, ArrowRight moves the unit cursor and tick is unchanged; Ctrl+F leaves filter closed; shortcuts OFF -> 's' inert; Space on a focused button activates once; Esc closes top overlay then deselects (selected+pinned); Help table equals registry (unit test).
findings.correction: Evidence verified (INPUT-only guard 112967, no modifier check, Mapbox keydown 89757-89811 preventDefaults arrows, keyboard default true 91902, speed 16 vs 8, H dead). Correction: a listener on #root is inert while focus is on <body> (page load / click outside root) although onboarding copy says 'Press Space or click Play to begin'; attach to document and gate on activeElement===body || root.contains(activeElement).

findings.title: Timeline and clock semantics: native integer slider with valuetext, day/speed groups, named transport, key-moments list, one clock formatter
findings.evidence: Slider min0 max100 step.01 (bundle.pretty.js:112294-112303) -> SR announces a percent; no label (Lighthouse label failure); parent onKeyDown (:112216) + outline:'none' (:112385); transport glyph buttons with title only (:112309-112338); 8px event dots div+title (:112270-112293); mobile scrubber touch-only (:103177); day/speed state by bg colour only (:112234,:112346); '1x (real time)' is wrong (_F :97429; real rate = 2 ticks/s = 10 game-min/s, cF=500 :96948); three clocks (:9371 06:00/04:00 base, :100836 and :100998 05:00 base) and two dates on the desktop screen (:113086 correct vs :97428 July+2).
findings.root_cause: Custom percent slider over a tick domain; clock logic copied into several components.
findings.fix: Native <input type=range min=1 max=675 step=1> with visible/sr label, aria-valuetext=formatBattleTime(tick) + '(moment n of 675)', aria-describedby key help, PageUp/PageDown +-12; day selector radiogroup (aria-checked/current); speed radiogroup showing the real rate; transport buttons with text names; 'Key moments' listbox button (8 named ticks TO :112192 + 118 high/critical chronology events) and invisible 24/44px buttons over the dots; drop wrapper handler/outline:none; ONE formatBattleTime()/getDay() used by toolbar, clock chip, slider, announcements, monuments, ancestor timeline, transcript. Do not ship valuetext before the C3/C4 clock fix.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse label passes; NVDA: 'Battle time, slider, <clock>, moment 267 of 675'; arrows move exactly one tick, PageUp/PageDown 12; unit test: formatBattleTime identical at all call sites for ticks 1,17,226,451,538,675; toolbar and chip show the same date.

findings.title: Data View: accessible table alternative to the canvas + auto-generated situation summary
findings.evidence: Units exist only as canvas pixels (lS bundle.pretty.js:96506) and non-interactive 7-11px text rows in OOB/roster (Xk :102321, Jk :102660, mobile :103505; 7px at :102611) that call unmodeled units 'Not on field' (:102303); data reality: 152 positioned units in 694 keyframes over 117 ticks (computed from data/placements_*.json), positions carried forward through module-global i2 (:96265-96305).
findings.root_cause: No DOM representation of the map data; four separate bespoke unlabeled lists.
findings.fix: <table> with caption, row-header unit + Select button, sortable header buttons (aria-sort), columns Side (text), Formation, Commander (with succession), Men now/start, Activity (text+glyph), Near (nearest of 30 terrain.json key_locations by haversine + 8-point bearing), Losses %; filters (side, corps, area, min strength, only units in contact via X4 :96480), 50-row pages, result count in role=status; per-row 'Show on map'; wording 'No position modeled'; describeMoment(tick) paragraph (counts, contact clusters near named places, latest event) used as aria-describedby of the map and on demand. One component replaces OOB, roster, search results, ancestor picker. Full-page ?view=text, side panel, and automatic fallback when WebGL/Mapbox fails.
findings.acceptance_test: NVDA table navigation reads 'Unit 20th Maine Infantry, Side Union, Men 358 of 386, Activity Line of Battle, Near Little Round Top'; axe table rules pass; tasks 5-8 of the 15-task AT script completed with the map hidden; render <30ms for 467 rows; Lighthouse a11y 100 on ?view=text.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 1.1.1, 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.3/1.4.9 (AAA); accessibility for non-visual users to A range; SEO/text content.
findings.correction: Line refs confirmed but the data claim is wrong: '152 units / 694 keyframes / 117 ticks' covers only placements_*.json. zp() (96900-96917) also loads 38 density_*.json (nF, 96788+) and merges them. Recomputed union as loaded by the app: 1,804 keyframes, 478 unit_ids (regiment and brigade-level ids), 188 ticks (placements 694/152/117; density 1,110/412/175). Data View caption, describeMoment and sizing must use the merged stream. Effort L -> XL.

findings.title: Keyboard unit cursor + map surface semantics + Mapbox keyboard integration
findings.evidence: Unit selection is canvas.onClick only (bundle.pretty.js:97365-97377,:97327-97351); Mapbox canvas is the only tabbable map element (role=region aria-label Map, tabindex 0, :94008-94023) and its keys collide with the app (:89757, :113050); overlay canvases lack aria-hidden (trail :96697, labels :9846, tint :9889).
findings.root_cause: Pointer-only hit-testing; no keyboard model for a canvas map.
findings.fix: Map surface role=application with aria-roledescription, instructions and aria-describedby (situation summary); Enter toggles 'unit cursor' mode; arrows move to the nearest unit in a +-60deg cone scored dist*(1+2*angle) over a pure projectVisible() extracted from lS (:96541-96552) and the existing grid index (aT :96388, Xx :96400); Enter/Space selects+pins and moves focus to the unit panel heading; [ ] order-of-battle traversal; G go-to-location combobox; Shift+arrows pan and +/- zoom via keyboard:false custom handler; announcements per policy ('20th Maine Infantry, Union, holding position, 358 men, facing southwest, about 300 yards north of Little Round Top. 3 of 41 in view'); two-tone cursor ring on the overlay canvas; aria-hidden+pointer-events:none on decorative canvases; camera eases to keep cursor unit in a 20% margin (instant under reduced motion).
findings.acceptance_test: Unit tests for step() on synthetic grids (right/left/up/down neighbours, off-axis penalty, null at edge); Playwright: focus map, Enter, ArrowRight x3 -> live-region text equals the Data View row; Enter -> unit panel heading focused; Esc leaves cursor mode; NVDA/JAWS pass arrows through and Tab leaves the map.

findings.title: Single-pointer/non-drag alternatives: on-screen pan and zoom, Go-to-location, mobile NavigationControl, minimap semantics
findings.evidence: Mobile map created without any control (bundle.pretty.js:102981-102989) vs desktop addControl(new NavigationControl(),'top-right') (:97252) -> zoom-out needs a two-finger gesture (2.5.1) and panning is drag-only (2.5.7); mobile minimap is static divs (:103288-103340); desktop minimap is a click-only canvas (:99811).
findings.root_cause: Mobile layout built separately and missing basic map controls.
findings.fix: Add NavigationControl({showCompass:false}) to mobile and walkthrough maps and enlarge Mapbox controls to 44px on (pointer:coarse); role=group 'Pan the map' D-pad (4 buttons + 'Center on selected unit') panning 25% of the view; 'Go to location' combobox (30 key_locations + 16 tour stops) shared with the G key; make minimap a button-wrapped control with arrow-key support or hide from AT and rely on Go-to-location.
findings.acceptance_test: On a 375px touch viewport zoom in/out and pan N/S/E/W with single taps only; Go-to-location 'Little Round Top' flies there (instant with reduced motion); axe/pa11y clean; manual TalkBack check.

findings.title: Live regions, persistent event log, status messages and time-limited content
findings.evidence: No aria-live/role=status|alert|log in the app. Toasts vanish at 4.5s (qF bundle.pretty.js:99909-99916), commander cards at 3s (:101707-101714), copy messages 2-4s (:97931,:101122, bookmarks chunk); 'No units found' not announced (:98946); clipboard failure -> window.prompt (:97932); bookmark delete has no undo.
findings.root_cause: Notifications rendered as transient visual divs; no announcer abstraction.
findings.fix: Three always-mounted regions (#gt-live-status role=status, #gt-live-alert role=alert, #gt-event-log role=log aria-live toggled by prefs); announce(text,{politeness}) helper with debounce/dedupe; toasts become log entries with Pause, pause-on-hover/focus, Clear, no auto-removal for errors (auto mode only if prefs.toasts==='auto'); commander cards and event card feed the same store; announcement matrix per report 6.8 (selection, jump, play/pause, events <=1 per 5s coalesced only when 'Announce battle events' ON, copy, search count, load, errors); replace window.prompt with inline read-only input; bookmark Undo.
findings.acceptance_test: NVDA reads 'Selected 20th Maine...' once per selection; events read only when the option is on; toasts persist until dismissed or paused; regions exist in DOM on load (not created on demand); Playwright asserts #gt-live-status text after each trigger.

findings.title: Screen-reader narrative alternative: static chronology transcript ('Battle Chronicle') generated from chronology + vignettes
findings.evidence: Narrative exists only as time-triggered panels (CF bundle.pretty.js:98252, LF :98595): 137 chronology events (45 critical, 73 high, 16 medium, 3 low) and 24 vignettes (~7,200 words) that appear/disappear with playback and are not reachable statically.
findings.root_cause: Content is bound to playback; no linear representation.
findings.fix:
Build-time static /battle-chronicle.html from data/chronology_day1..3.json + vignettes_part1..3.json: one h1, h2 per day, h3 per hour block, each event a

with , text significance label, units as links and 'Show this moment on the map' (/?t=TICK, requires app-a11y-26); TOC nav, skip-to-day links, print CSS; same component as in-app Battle Log; add to sitemap, footer, Help, Extra Features; replaces crawler-only #seo-content.
findings.acceptance_test: axe/pa11y 0 violations, exactly one h1, order verified by script against data ticks/times, Lighthouse 100 x4, every entry link opens the map at that tick, NVDA headings list shows Day 1/2/3 + hour groups.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 1.1.1 alternative, 2.4.10 (AAA), SEO T1/E4; content depth for AT users.

findings.title: Accessible names, roles and states for every control (75 button sites, 18+3+2 close glyphs, toolbar, tabs, toggles)
findings.evidence: 0 of 75 button sites have aria-*; toolbar Vs (bundle.pretty.js:113287) name = letter/emoji with title only as description, active state colour-only; the index.html LABELS patch is inert (skips buttons that have a title, :414); 18 '✕' in main bundle (+3 chunks, +2 letter 'X' :112532,:112881); Play and Next both '▶' (:112321,:112327); two buttons for one function ('S' :113145 and '🔍 Find Unit / Location' :113212); tabs/toggles/segmented groups without roles.
findings.root_cause: Icon glyphs as labels; no shared button primitive.
findings.fix: IconButton {icon,label,pressed?,expanded?,controls?,keyshortcut?} rendering <button type=button aria-label aria-pressed aria-expanded aria-controls aria-keyshortcuts title> + aria-hidden SVG from the existing site-nav sprite (replaces emoji/letters, H6); segmented groups (Side, Unit type, Disposition, Sort, Speed, Day) as radiogroup or aria-pressed sets, Legend/Help/Walkthrough tabs as tablist/tab/tabpanel with arrow keys; aria-current for active day/stop/story; text names per report 2.2; merge the two search buttons; unify 'Close'.
findings.acceptance_test: axe button-name, aria-toggle-field-name, aria-allowed-attr pass; testing-library sweep asserts every button in every state has a non-empty name containing its visible text (2.5.3); Dragon/Voice Access 'click Search'/'click Filter' work.

findings.title: Forms and search: labels, combobox pattern, Distance tool without a mouse, errors and empty states
findings.evidence: 10 form-control sites: search/ancestor/monument inputs placeholder-only with outline:none (bundle.pretty.js:98996,:101356); filter range unnamed (:99255); Layers checkbox text is a span not a label (:112556-112564); Distance tool click-on-map only (GtbgDist :112758-112837) with results not announced; filter chips lack aria-pressed.
findings.root_cause: Inputs built without labels or patterns; map-click-only tool.
findings.fix: Visible label or aria-label for all inputs; unit search as ARIA 1.2 combobox+listbox (aria-expanded/controls/activedescendant/autocomplete, arrows/Enter/Esc, result count via status); Layers as <fieldset><legend> with real <label>s; Distance tool form alternative (From/To comboboxes of units/locations -> yards/metres/feet + march time in role=status) alongside click mode, drawing the line for both (fixes H12); bookmark name labelled with empty validation; sliders with aria-valuetext.
findings.acceptance_test: axe label/aria-input-field-name/autocomplete-valid pass; keyboard-only user measures Little Round Top -> Cemetery Hill and hears the result; combobox announces '5 results' in NVDA and VoiceOver.

findings.title: Landmarks, headings, skip links, document title; fold the injected Extra Features overlay into the real header
findings.evidence: App has 0 landmarks and 1 heading (bundle.pretty.js:110648,:110700). #extra-features is a fixed z-index:999999 element outside React whose corner is picked by a collision mover (index.html:176-206,:521-606), force-revealed after 5s even during onboarding (:202), first in DOM order, and overlaps the story panel (:98418) and toasts (:100008).
findings.root_cause: Overlay bolted on via injected scripts because the toolbar could not be edited.
findings.fix: Semantic skeleton: header (h1), toolbar role=toolbar aria-label, Extra Features + Ask the Historian as a normal menu-button in the header nav (delete fixed overlay, collision mover, reveal script, timers), main, aside, footer; h2 for every panel/dialog; skip links (map, timeline, unit list); update document.title on view/day/panel change (throttled) and focus new panel headings; Extra Features menu with aria-haspopup/controls, focus into menu, Esc returns focus.
findings.acceptance_test: axe landmark-*, region, page-has-heading-one, heading-order, bypass pass in every state; NVDA landmarks = banner, navigation, main, complementary, contentinfo; Playwright hit-test at each Tab stop: elementFromPoint(center) is the focused element or its descendant.

findings.title: Design tokens and contrast to AA (AAA where cheap), CI-enforced
findings.evidence: contrast2.py: 62 of 234 inline text styles fail 4.5:1 (#444 2.02, #555 2.64 x12 uses, #666 3.43 x31, #777 4.40, #8b6914-as-text 3.87, #3a6bc4-as-text 3.83, #cc4444-as-text 4.20, rgba gold .45 2.54, #6d7a8a ~3.6); Lighthouse fails 2 (mobile)/4 (desktop) live nodes; non-text: chip OFF border 1.56, input border 2.00, timeline markers 2.35, slider track 1.9; disabled by opacity .3 (bundle.pretty.js:98359,:98380); site-nav #6f7686 4.08/4.32.
findings.root_cause: Hard-coded hex literals in ~300 inline style entries; no token layer or contrast test.
findings.fix: tokens.css (custom properties) consumed everywhere: text-1 #f4f0e4, text-gold #e8d5a3, text-2 #c8c8d2, text-3 #a8a8b8, text-4 #9a9aab, muted-floor #8f8fa3 (non-essential only), gold-text #c8a84a, gold-text-dim #b8963c, link #7fa8ff, danger #f07a7a, ok #6fd08c, warn #ffb454; border-ui #7a7a92 (4.7:1), border-ui-soft #6a6a80, gold border #8b6914 (3.87:1 ok as border); disabled via aria-disabled not opacity; lint banning raw hex; contrast.test.ts reads tokens.css and asserts >=4.5 text (>=7 for AAA-marked) and >=3 borders per pairing.
findings.acceptance_test: contrast.test.ts green; axe color-contrast 0 across the state matrix; Lighthouse a11y 100 both form factors in all states; picker spot-check of 20 elements.

findings.title: Colour-independent encoding: luminance-separated sides + hatch + letters, disposition glyphs, imagery halo, CVD-safe palette, one palette object for canvas/legend/badges
findings.evidence: Side fills #3a6bc4/#c43a3a (bundle.pretty.js:96427-96428): luminance contrast 1.02:1, CIEDE2000 protan 42/deutan 51/tritan 66/achromat 0.4; labels #aaccff/#ffbbaa 1.01:1; disposition = 7px colour-only dot (:96644-96651); canvas Lp (:96306) != legend NF (:99384) != badges fA (:98090), 'Line of Battle' has no colour (Lp null); legend says 'Dot outline = side color' (:99519) but no outline is drawn; unit fill vs satellite tones 1.5-2.5:1; map lines 1.3-3.9:1; 'blue dot in Herbst Woods'/'red wave' tour copy (:111839,:111851).
findings.root_cause: Colour is the only channel; palettes duplicated per component.
findings.fix: palette.ts {side:{union,confed}, disposition:{glyph,color}} feeding canvas, legend, badges, roster, Data View. Default sides Union #6fb1ff / Confederate #b3261e (luminance contrast 2.9:1; protan 59, deutan 56, tritan 65, achromat 29), Confederate also hatched (canvas createPattern) with a trailing notch, labels prefixed 'U'/'C'; disposition glyphs (>=12px: charging up-triangle, retreat down-triangle, line bar, march arrow, reserve diamond, bivouac dot, artillery star, limbered x) beside units and in legend/lists; two-tone halo (1px #fff + 1px #000) on units/glyphs (max of contrast vs white/black >=4.58 for any background); 2px black casing under map lines; Settings palette 'Colour-blind safe' (Okabe-Ito #0072B2/#D55E00 + hatch) and 'High contrast'; rewrite legend copy and tour text.
findings.acceptance_test: palette.test.ts asserts dE2000 >=25 between sides under protan/deutan/tritan/achromat and side luminance contrast >=2.5:1; DevTools vision-deficiency screenshots show all 11 dispositions and both sides identifiable by glyph/pattern alone; canvas pixel test halo contrast >=3:1 on 5 satellite tiles.

findings.title: Type scale in rem, 12px floor, user text-size control, canvas label scaling
findings.evidence: 268 fontSize literals in the app region, 133 <12px, 21 <=9px, min 7px (bundle.pretty.js:102611), 8px x7 (:102287-102310,:102594-102599,:103294); all px so OS/browser text-size preferences are ignored; canvas labels 8/9/10px (:96663); Mapbox labels 9-10px (:9763,:9788); nowrap/ellipsis and fixed heights (toolbar 48, mobile bars) clip under text spacing.
findings.root_cause: Absolute px inline styles; fixed-height containers.
findings.fix: --fs-* rem tokens replace every literal via codemod (12px floor: 7-11 -> --fs-xs); html font-size = 16px * --gt-font-scale set by Settings (100/125/150/200%); text containers use min-height+padding; remove nowrap/ellipsis in OOB/roster/unit-value rows in favour of wrapping; canvas labels drawn at max(12,12*scale) with existing zoom-gated collision culling (:96653-96663); Mapbox symbol text-size >=12. Interim: shim font floor (finding 01).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright: computed font-size of every visible text node >=12px in all states; WCAG text-spacing injection (line-height 1.5, letter-spacing .12em, word-spacing .16em, paragraph 2em) leaves no clipped/overlapping text; 200% text scale keeps every control reachable.

findings.title: Target size: 44px on touch, >=32px on desktop pointers, never <24px
findings.evidence: index.html:61 resets padding:0 so unstyled buttons collapse: estimated 11-20 x 13-25px for 18+ close glyphs (bundle.pretty.js:98169,:98468,:99329,:100540,:103870,:103937,:104061), 6-8px dots (:98500,:100497,:112277), speed buttons ~26x20 (:112442), disposition chips ~22px tall (:99366), toolbar 28x26 (:113356), Mapbox controls 29x29, mobile scrubber track 36px; only a few 44px buttons (:101341,:102118,:103820). Lighthouse target-size passed only for the initial state.
findings.root_cause: No shared hit-area primitive; padding reset.
findings.fix: IconButton/Chip/Tab primitives enforce min-width/min-height var(--hit-min) = 44px under (pointer:coarse), 32px otherwise (documented AAA deviation for the dense desktop toolbar); invisible hit areas for 6-8px visuals (position:relative + ::after inset:-9px); 8px gaps; 44px mobile scrubber thumb hit area; Mapbox controls 44px on coarse pointers; never rely on the 2.5.8 spacing exemption.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright sweep over visible button,a[href],input,select,summary,[role=button|tab|radio|option|slider] in each state: bounding box >=24x24 (fine) / >=44x44 (hasTouch+isMobile context) with an explicit allow-list; CSV output reviewed; axe target-size passes all states.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 2.5.8 (AA), 2.5.5 (AAA); mobile usability D+ -> B+ (with 20/24); BRIEF 44px touch rule.
findings.correction: Estimates plausible and padding:0 reset confirmed at index.html:61, but Mapbox v3.24.1 control buttons are 32x32 (.mapboxgl-ctrl-group button{height:32px;width:32px;outline:none} in index-B4G7Z_2G.css), not 29x29; still under 44.

findings.title: Reflow, zoom, text spacing, landscape: one responsive tree by container width, toolbar overflow, no load-time layout constants
findings.evidence: index.html:62-70 html/body overflow:hidden + #root fixed contain:strict; desktop toolbar = three clusters (title+day+tick ~290-300px, absolutely centred cluster ~540px, 13 buttons ~420-470px, bundle.pretty.js:113074-113232,:113336) estimated to collide below ~1400px viewport; timeline controls nowrap ~800px (:112425); search panel 440px translateX(-50%) (:98953); style constants computed once from window.innerWidth (:98111-98115,:102708-102712); desktop-vs-mobile is a user click (dO) so zoomed desktop users are never switched; mobile fixed 52+42+140px chrome (:103715,:103744,:103770).
findings.root_cause: Fixed pixel clusters and a hard desktop/mobile fork.
findings.fix: CSS layout modes by container width (>=1100 wide, 640-1099 medium, <640 narrow) on #root via container queries/ResizeObserver; the chooser sets the default, not a fork. Toolbar priority+ pattern with 'More tools' menu-button (ResizeObserver), no overlap; timeline wraps to two rows <720px, speed becomes select <480px, credit/e-mail to footer; panels width:min(440px,calc(100vw-24px)), max-height calc(100dvh - chrome), inset-inline centring; replace window.innerWidth constants with CSS; allow #root scroll at <320x256 (map exempt as 2-D content); landscape phones collapse bars to 44px with safe-area insets; drop manifest orientation lock (29).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright at 1440x900, 1280x720, 1366x768, 1024x768, 768x1024, 375x812, 812x375, 320x256: (a) no horizontal scroll outside the map, (b) pairwise overlap detector on visible interactive elements returns none, (c) every toolbar action reachable by Tab, (d) text-spacing injection leaves no clipping.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 1.4.10, 1.4.4, 1.4.12, 1.3.4 (AA); BRIEF 'no overlap/clip 320-2560 and landscape'; Fit & finish/Usability on mobile.
findings.correction: Structure verified (centre cluster left:50% 113336, 440px search panel translateX(-50%) 98953-98968, load-time innerWidth constants 98111/102708, nowrap controls 112425). Overlap thresholds are estimates without a browser; my arithmetic gives collision below ~1,470 px, consistent with ~1,400. Run the sweep first.

findings.title: Motion: honour prefers-reduced-motion in the app, add an in-app control, make intro and tour stoppable
findings.evidence: Only boot splash, #extra-features and site-nav overlays respect reduced motion (index.html:139,:206,:252; site-nav.css:14,:53,:82); the app does not: intro fast-forward eO=3500 (bundle.pretty.js:101471), contact-glow 0.4+0.6*abs(sin(t/300)) (:96615, ~1.06Hz), sub-tick interpolation (:97001), 8s tint transition (:9895), NPS tour autoplay with timeouts Esc cannot stop (:100329-100341), trails default on (:97219); Mapbox flyTo does respect it (:11447).
findings.root_cause: No motion preference plumbing in app code.
findings.fix: useMotion() from prefs.motion (system->matchMedia): reduced => skip intro, solid halo instead of pulse, positions step per tick, trails default off, tint instant, flyTo->jumpTo, tour advances only on user action, default speed 1x; full => keep but give tour/intro visible Pause/Skip and Esc. Interim: bundle patch J in finding 02.
findings.acceptance_test: emulateMedia reducedMotion:reduce -> splash absent within 200ms, canvas frames identical across two rAF ticks at the same tick, no rAF loop while paused; in-app setting overrides OS; tour has Pause and Esc stops it.

findings.title: Hover-only and title-only content (1.4.13): monument markers, timeline markers, toolbar tooltips; remove the duplicate injected star overlay
findings.evidence: Monument markers are div onMouseEnter/Leave with a pointerEvents:none tooltip (bundle.pretty.js:100914-100959,:100974) - not focusable, hoverable or dismissible; timeline markers rely on title (:112275); toolbar buttons on title (:113291); index.html:608-714 injects a second hard-coded star overlay on the same Monuments button with title tooltips and known drift on pan/zoom (its own comment :620-622); dead hover popup fF (:97063).
findings.root_cause: Hover handlers on divs; two implementations of the same feature.
findings.fix: Markers -> <button aria-label='{name}. {label}. Jump to {time}' aria-describedby> with a native Popover shown on hover AND focus, hoverable with a 300ms grace, Esc-dismissible, persistent while focused; timeline markers -> Key-moments list (07); toolbar tooltips built from the label with the same rules; delete the injected star overlay and dead fF.
findings.acceptance_test: Tab to a marker -> popover text visible and read via aria-describedby; pointer can move onto it without closing; Esc hides it; exactly one marker per monument (20 React markers from mA :100615, none from the injected overlay which loads a different 9-entry data/monuments.json).

findings.title: Focus visibility and focus-not-obscured: two-tone ring, remove outline:none sites, retire the floating overlay
findings.evidence: Inline outline:'none' on search input (bundle.pretty.js:98996), ancestor input (:101356), timeline wrapper (:112385); site-nav.css:43-47 and :110 remove outlines on the Historian pin and menu cards (replacement change 1.14:1 and 1.71:1, computed); global ring #c9a24b is 1.15:1 over wheat-field imagery (tokens.py); #extra-features fixed z 999999 moves among six positions (index.html:176-206,:535-590) and can cover a focused control; mobile bottom bars cover content.
findings.root_cause: Per-element outline suppression; fixed overlay above everything.
findings.fix: Focus token :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #000} for every focusable incl. inputs; delete the three inline outline:none and the two site-nav.css removals; scroll-padding/scroll-margin so focused rows are not hidden under fixed bars; remove the floating overlay (15) so nothing fixed sits over focusable content; add the focus-not-obscured sweep.
findings.acceptance_test: Tab through every state: elementFromPoint(centre of focused element) is the element or descendant for 100% of stops; ring contrast >=3:1 on 5 imagery samples; manual: ring visible on the Historian pin.
findings.correction: Outline-none sites are 98995 (not 98996), 101356, 112385 plus two missed in Walkthrough (111557, 111744); Mapbox control CSS also sets outline:none; site-nav.css 43-47/110 confirmed and are editable now (Phase 0), not source-dependent.

findings.title: Mobile layout accessibility: one control set, native scrubber, dialog sheets, zoom buttons, no covered focusables, pinch-zoom allowed
findings.evidence: AO renders desktop IO timeline (bundle.pretty.js:113249), XF (:113252), VF (:113244), WF (:113245), KF (:113250), CF/LF/_F (:113246-113248), qF (:113259), MF (:113283) in every layout while pO is a second full-screen tree (:113061-113064, root zIndex 100 :103703); IO (zIndex 100 :112386) is later in DOM order so it paints over pO's bottom bar = root cause of C1/C2 (the 572px transport row is IO's Po.controls). AT consequences: duplicate Play/Prev/Next, focusable controls hidden under UI; scrubber touch-only (:103177); tools sheet is a div overlay (:103368); touch-action:none root (:103705) likely blocks pinch-zoom; mobile map has no zoom buttons (:102981); icon spans duplicate labels ('FFilter', :103494).
findings.root_cause: Mobile layout added as a parallel tree without unmounting desktop chrome.
findings.fix: Mount only the active layout's controls (or the single responsive tree of 20); hidden = unmounted or inert; scrubber -> native slider (07); Tools sheet -> <dialog> with aria-labelledby, 44px rows, icon spans aria-hidden; root touch-action: pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom (map canvas keeps its own none); NavigationControl/D-pad (10); safe-area insets; 44px targets (19); landscape behaviour (20).
findings.acceptance_test: In mobile layout document.querySelectorAll('button') contains exactly one Play button; hit-test of every focusable centre returns itself (C2 acceptance); browser pinch-zoom to 200% works on Chrome Android; TalkBack swipe order = top bar, day tabs, map summary, timeline, tools; axe clean on 6 mobile states.

findings.title: Virtual Walkthrough view: tabs, monument cards, heading hierarchy, labels, iframe titles
findings.evidence: No h1 (title is a span, bundle.pretty.js:110869,:110989) though h2/h3 exist (:110648,:110700); tab buttons without role=tab (:110879,:111156); chips active by class only (:110901,:111227); monument cards div onClick with 100 identical 'View on map' links (:110690-110731,:110726); placeholder-only search inputs (:110928,:111213); unlabeled select (:111241); Street View iframe title = stop name only (:110665); 100-item cap message not announced (:110963,:111291); Mapbox attribution disabled (:110777,:102988 - verify licensing).
findings.root_cause: Separate view built without shared primitives.
findings.fix: h1 'Virtual Walkthrough'; tablist/tab/tabpanel with arrow keys; stop chips aria-current; monument list <ul> of <article> (h3) with a 'Fly to on map' <button> and 'View {name} on Google Maps (opens new tab)' link; labelled search/select; result count role=status ('Showing 100 of 512 - refine your search'); iframe title 'Street View panorama near {name}' with the existing Open-in-Google-Maps link as fallback; NPS video link aria-label 'Watch NPS video for {name} (opens nps.gov)'; accessible name and list alternative for the map.
findings.acceptance_test: axe/pa11y clean on both branches (mobile kr, desktop Tn); NVDA headings list H1 -> stops; keyboard user opens stop 5 and reaches its Street View link; count announced after each filter.

findings.title: Accessibility settings dialog + URL state (deep links) + working share links
findings.evidence: Share/bookmark URLs ?t=&u=&z=&ll= are written ($k bundle.pretty.js:97823-97830, bookmark url :97862) but never read - the only URLSearchParams get is 'ancestor' (:101019); gtbg_prefs holds only showLegend/showMinimap (:9327-9341,:9417-9418); layout/view unpersisted (H3).
findings.root_cause: No state-in-URL layer; preferences store barely used.
findings.fix: parseUrlState() on load and popstate for t,u,z,ll,ancestor,view,layout,intro,motion,palette,contrast (validated/clamped); replaceState on share/bookmark; Settings dialog with live preview persisted in gtbg_prefs (view, motion, contrast, palette, textScale, shortcuts, announce, toasts); URL test hooks (?intro=0&layout=desktop&view=text&motion=reduce) documented for the CI state matrix.
findings.acceptance_test: Opening a copied link restores tick, selected unit, zoom and centre; invalid params ignored; settings persist and apply before first paint; Playwright state matrix reaches every state using only URL params.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Fixes a functional bug (share links), unblocks findings 12/32, supports 3.2.6/2.2.6-style continuity.

findings.title: Copy, debug text and dead-code hygiene that affects AT and clarity
findings.evidence: User-visible FPS debug on canvas (bundle.pretty.js:96684-96687) and clock chip (:97446-97448); dead hover popup fF (:97063); dead H heatmap (:113022, Help, onboarding :111995); dead HelpModal useGlobalKeyboard; undefined keyframes slideIn (:100024); Help 'About' says 445+ units (H10) and Esc text partly false; OOB abbreviations MG/BG/LG/Gen/Col (:102536-102547); 'Not on field' for unmodeled units (:102303,:103555); 'Trails ON/OFF' with a wavy-dash glyph (:97382); two names for one action.
findings.root_cause: Debug and legacy code shipped; copy typed instead of derived.
findings.fix: Delete FPS overlays (opt-in ?debug=fps), fF, H shortcut, useGlobalKeyboard, slideIn; Help generated from the shortcut registry and data (unit count computed); expand abbreviations or <abbr title>; wording 'No position modeled'; decorative glyphs aria-hidden; single search entry point.
findings.acceptance_test: grep of the built bundle for fps, hoveredUnit, toggleHeatmap, slideIn, '445+' returns nothing; Help table equals registry (unit test); 3.1.4 check on OOB.

findings.title: Errors are invisible: map/WebGL/data failures need messages and a fallback to Text view
findings.evidence: Bulk loads have no error path (iF bundle.pretty.js:96834-96899 Promise.all+json with no catch; rF :96919; oF :96923); zp swallows failures as empty arrays (:96909); Mapbox 'error' event unhandled (map init :97237-97261); no WebGL check; boot splash has no timeout/failure state (index.html:742-748); clipboard failure -> window.prompt (:97932).
findings.root_cause: Happy-path-only data/map loading.
findings.fix: Central loadData() with per-file retry (2x, back-off) and a role=alert banner ('Some battle data could not be loaded (3 of 30). Retry / Continue in Text view'); map.on('error') -> announce + offer Text view; mapboxgl.supported() false -> open Text view automatically; boot splash role=status with progress text ('Loading battle data 12 of 30') and a 10s timeout message with Retry; aria-busy on the map while loading.
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright route.abort() on 3 JSON files and WebGL disabled -> alert text present and Text view usable; Mapbox token blocked -> banner; NVDA announces the alert.

findings.title: PWA and reload behaviour: remove the landscape orientation lock and the first-visit forced reload
findings.evidence: manifest.json 'orientation':'landscape' (E1); index.html:263-268 controllerchange -> location.reload(); sw.js skipWaiting()+clients.claim() (C6).
findings.root_cause: Aggressive SW update strategy and copy-pasted manifest field.
findings.fix: Delete the orientation member (or 'any'); remove the forced reload; show a non-blocking role=status 'A new version is available - Refresh' with a keyboard-reachable button when a waiting worker exists and reload only on request (3.2.5); drop skipWaiting.
findings.acceptance_test: Installed PWA rotates to portrait; first visit performs one navigation (no redirectCount); update message appears after a deploy and is announced.
findings.correction: manifest orientation and controllerchange reload confirmed. The first-visit double load comes from clients.claim() firing controllerchange into the reload handler, so deleting the handler suffices for C6; dropping skipWaiting is unnecessary for it and would leave the new SW waiting (old gbg-v5 cache kept) while the pipeline relies on a CACHE_NAME bump. sw.js navigations are network-first so new HTML still arrives. Decide skipWaiting together with the chunk-rename fix.

findings.title: Cheap Level AAA set: implementation and sign-off checklist
findings.root_cause: AAA never targeted.
findings.fix: Implement and record in the ACR: 7:1 body tokens, line-height >=1.5 + text-size control + no horizontal scroll at 200%, keyboard-complete map, persistent log/optional toasts, reduce-motion, headings in every panel, no fixed overlays, two-tone ring, 44px on touch (documented desktop toolbar deviation), abbreviations, no auto-reload, per-panel 'How to use' link, bookmark undo.
findings.acceptance_test: Each item has an automated or manual test in section 9 and an ACR row marked 'Supports'.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: AAA conformance on the cheap set; documentation.

findings.title: Retire the legacy injected scripts in index.html (inert label patch, banner scraper, reveal/collision scripts, duplicate star overlay)
findings.evidence: index.html:398-440 label patch is inert (skips buttons with title; 25x polling); :355-396 scrapes DOM text; :441-519 click-text sniffing + 1.5s/10s timers + 5s CSS force-reveal (:202); :521-606 collision mover; :608-714 star overlay duplicating KF; :255-277 SW forced reload.
findings.root_cause: Workarounds accumulated because the app source was not editable.
findings.fix: Delete label patch, banner injector (copy moves into Entry dialog), reveal + collision mover (with the overlay, 15), star overlay (22); port populate into the header component; SW reload per 29. index.html then keeps only the reduced-motion flag and JSON-LD scripts.
findings.acceptance_test: index.html has no inline <script> other than the reduced-motion flag and JSON-LD; the removed behaviours exist as tested React components.

findings.title: Automated accessibility test infrastructure and CI gates (Playwright+axe state matrix, pa11y-ci, LHCI, jsx-a11y, token/palette/cursor unit tests, sweeps)
findings.evidence: No tests exist for the deployed app (N1); Lighthouse tested only the load state. Report section 9 includes runnable Playwright specs for ~24 URL-reachable states x {desktop 1440x900, mobile touch} x {default, reduced-motion, forced-colors}.
findings.root_cause: No source-level test harness; states not URL-addressable.
findings.fix: tests/a11y/state-matrix.spec.ts (Playwright + @axe-core/playwright, tags wcag2a/aa/21/22aa/best-practice, fail on violations and serious incomplete); regression specs for key conflicts, Ctrl+F, Space-on-button, dialog focus in/trap/Esc/restore, target size, overlap, focus-not-obscured, font-size floor, text spacing, 400% reflow, reduced motion, CDP vision-deficiency screenshots; pa11y-ci.json with actions; lighthouserc.js (a11y=1, color-contrast, label, button-name, heading-order, bypass, target-size as errors); eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y strict + stylelint (no raw hex, font-size >=0.75rem); vitest unit tests: contrast tokens, palette dE2000, step() cursor, formatBattleTime consistency, shortcut guards, announce debounce. CI per PR, nightly against production, Netlify deploy-preview gate.
findings.acceptance_test: CI fails on any new axe violation, contrast-token regression, missing accessible name or target <24px; green baseline committed; nightly production run posts results.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Locks in A+ (regression protection); BRIEF 'tested' bar.
findings.correction: STATES array has 24 entries vs 'about 45 states' in the finding/8.2; the matrix depends on URL hooks from 26 (source-level), so a Tier-0 harness needs a gtbg_onboarded seed + click-through; the reduced-motion test asserts absence of splash text immediately after goto (racy); LHCI assertions on bypass are meaningless because bypass is informative in Lighthouse 13 - use axe directly.

findings.title: Manual assistive-technology program: scripts, matrix, exit criteria (15 core tasks)
findings.evidence: Nothing in the app has been tested with a screen reader, voice control or forced colours (audit 'Not tested'); Lighthouse a11y covers only an automated subset.
findings.root_cause: No AT testing cadence.
findings.fix: Run the 15 core tasks (cold load/skip link, entry, play/pause/speed, Key moments to Pickett's Charge, situation summary, search+select 20th Maine, step time, story/Battle Log, filter Confederate artillery, Follow Ancestor + share link, bookmark+undo, Extra Features/Historian/Back, Walkthrough stop 5 + Street View, unit cursor Little Round Top -> Peach Orchard, keyboard-only distance measure) on NVDA+Firefox/Chrome, JAWS+Chrome, VoiceOver macOS Safari, VoiceOver iOS Safari, TalkBack+Chrome, Windows Voice Access/Dragon, Windows contrast themes, 200%/400% zoom, keyboard-only; log in docs/a11y/test-log.md, file/re-test defects; paid session with 2-3 AT users before declaring A+.
findings.acceptance_test: Every task passes on every matrix row with no workaround, in <=2x median sighted-mouse time; log committed.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Converts 'no automated violations' into verified usability; feeds the ACR.
findings.correction: 15 tasks x ~8 AT/browser rows = ~120 runs plus logging, defect re-test and 2-3 paid user sessions: effort L, not M.

findings.title: Accessibility statement, WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Conformance Report (VPAT 2.5) and feedback channel; accessible PDF guide
findings.evidence: No accessibility statement exists; user-guide.pdf metadata '(anonymous)' and layout issues (G1); privacy/terms pages omit accessibility contact.
findings.root_cause: Accessibility not documented or promised.
findings.fix: /accessibility.html (footer, Help, Extra Features): conformance claim WCAG 2.2 AA (+ noted AAA), scope, known limitations (imagery decorative, third-party NPS video captions, Google Street View embeds), how to use Text view/keyboard help, contact e-mail with 2-business-day response, last-test date; docs/a11y/ACR-WCAG2.2.md generated from the test log; tag the PDF guide (real headings, alt text, title/metadata) and add a shortcuts page.
findings.acceptance_test: Page passes axe/pa11y/Lighthouse; ACR rows mirror the criterion table with 'Supports' evidence links; PDF passes PAC 2024 / Acrobat checker.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Documentation B -> A; Privacy/legal B+ -> A-.
findings.correction: No accessibility page exists; user-guide.pdf metadata confirms '(anonymous)' and producer 'ReportLab PDF Library - (opensource)'. ReportLab open-source likely cannot emit a PDF/UA structure tree (unverified), so a tagged PDF probably means changing the generator; with a 55-row ACR the effort is M, not S.

open_questions: Is a buildable source available (N1)? If not, only Phase 0 (findings 01, 02, 29) is possible: Lighthouse ~100 but real conformance stays low (no Data View, unit cursor, dialog semantics or non-colour encodings).
Which clock is authoritative (C3/C4)? aria-valuetext, live announcements and the chronology transcript must not ship before the single formatBattleTime() is fixed or they will speak wrong times.

Lighthouse reports landmark-one-main as passing although the app renders no <main>; I could not reconcile this (the bypass audit output is unambiguous). Verify with a manual accessibility-tree inspection.
Target sizes and toolbar/timeline overlap widths are estimates from style objects; run the Playwright target-size/overlap/text-spacing sweeps first and treat their output as truth.

role=application on the map surface must be validated with NVDA/JAWS (browse/focus mode transitions) and iOS/TalkBack; Text view is the safety net. Native <dialog> top-layer behaviour over Mapbox must be verified on iOS Safari and Firefox ESR; React 18.3 lacks an inert prop (use inert='' or el.inert).
Are NPS videos (nps.gov links in the tour/walkthrough) captioned/audio-described, and does the Google Street View iframe let keyboard users Tab out? Both are third-party and unverified.
Default for 'Announce battle events' (proposed OFF) and whether Text view should be the default on first visit for AT users are judgement calls to validate with real AT users.
The Tier-0 CSS font floor and colour overrides change dense inline-styled panels; visual QA at 4 widths is required before deploy (failure mode is cosmetic).
Mobile and Walkthrough Mapbox maps disable the attribution control (bundle.pretty.js:102988, :110777): check Mapbox ToS (legal/security specialist).

Placement data cover only 152 units in 694 keyframes (117 ticks) while the UI advertises 467 units and carries positions forward via a module-global; the Data View wording ('No position modeled') depends on the data specialist's decision (H10).
verification_summary: The specialist's evidence is unusually accurate. I re-opened about 150 line citations and all were within 0-2 lines. Every number I recomputed reproduced. That covers the contrast ratios, 62/234 failing styles, 133/268/21/7px font sizes, 152/694/117 placements, 137 events (45/73/16/3), 24 vignettes (7,205 words), and the 18 patch FIND counts (+1,850 bytes, node --check OK). The defects are in delivery mechanics, one data claim, acceptance arithmetic and effort, not in the findings' existence. Two would cause a production regression if shipped as written. First, finding 02's re-hash pipeline rewrites the lazy chunks in place under the same immutable, cache-first filenames. Returning visitors would then load the old chunk, which imports the old main bundle and re-runs its createRoot mount. Second, the plan's Tier-0 patch set collides with app-mobile's hot-fix pack. Applying the 18 FINDs to app-mobile's patched bundle fails 2 counts (G-close-mobile 3 vs 4, J1 0 vs 1), so the pipeline's refuse-on-mismatch rule aborts. Finding 08's data claim is also wrong. The app merges 38 density_*.json files with the 9 placements files, giving 1,804 keyframes, 478 unit ids and 188 ticks, not 152/694/117. Verdicts: 22 CONFIRMED (20 fully, plus 20 confirmed for structure with its thresholds unverifiable) and 12 CORRECTED (01, 02, 03, 06, 08, 19, 23, 29, 32, 33, 34; 08 counted once). Finding 17's satellite-tone ratios are UNVERIFIABLE because those hex tones were assumed. A "## Verification" section was appended to app-a11y.md; my scripts are in plan-work/tmp-verify-app-a11y/.

missed_by_specialist.title: Tier-0 patch pipelines of app-a11y (02) and app-mobile collide and share the stale-chunk defect
missed_by_specialist.evidence: tmp-app-mobile/apply_patches.py (68 edits) patches the same minified bundle, index.html:55/282 and sw.js and renames output to index-mHF1a.js. Overlaps: eO=3500 (HF-10h vs 02-J1), tn.toolsClose close button (HF-6l vs 02-G regex), Va.skip/skipBtn (HF-10f/11c vs 02-F), tn.root touch-action (HF-8a vs finding 24). Re-running the specialist's 18 FINDs (tmp-verify-app-a11y/bpc.py) against tmp-app-mobile/patched/assets/index-mHF1a.js: 16 OK, G-close-mobile 3 vs 4, J1-intro-duration 0 vs 1. The mobile pack renames only the main bundle and leaves both chunks importing ./index-Cg8FAMXN.js, which stays in assets/.
missed_by_specialist.fix: One merged, ordered patch list (mobile pack then a11y with adjusted counts), one count-asserting script, one output content-hash, both lazy chunks renamed too with the two import() specifiers updated, one CACHE_NAME bump.

missed_by_specialist.title: Tier-0 shell skeleton gaps: dead/ineffective skip links and h1 outside a landmark
missed_by_specialist.evidence: index.html toolbar sits inside #root before the map, so skip target #root bypasses nothing; #gt-timeline is the id patched onto IO, and app-mobile HF-1a gates IO with Zn!=='mobile' so on phones the second skip link has no target; the proposed sr-only h1 sits directly under body outside any landmark, tripping axe 'region' (best-practice tag used in the report's own state matrix).
missed_by_specialist.fix: Add id='gt-map' + tabIndex:-1 to the map container via bundle patch and target it; emit the timeline skip link only when its target exists (or give the mobile dock a target); put the h1 inside <header>.

missed_by_specialist.title: Modal <dialog>.showModal() makes the proposed live regions inert, silencing announcements while a modal is open
missed_by_specialist.evidence: Finding 05 moves Bookmarks, Follow Ancestor, Soldier's Eye, Help etc. to native modal dialogs; finding 11/6.8 routes 'Link copied', search counts and errors through always-mounted #gt-live-status/#gt-live-alert/#gt-event-log outside the dialog. showModal() inerts everything outside the dialog (removed from the accessibility tree), so those updates are not announced.
missed_by_specialist.fix: announce() writes to a live region inside the top-most open dialog when one exists; keep global regions for non-modal state; verify with NVDA+Firefox and VoiceOver.

missed_by_specialist.title: Mapbox canvas stays a second tab stop and nested role under the proposed role=application map surface
missed_by_specialist.evidence: Mapbox sets tabindex=0, role=region and aria-label on its own canvas (bundle.pretty.js:94003-94025); finding 09 adds a wrapper #gt-map tabindex=0 role=application, giving two tab stops for one map and nested roles.
missed_by_specialist.fix: After map load set map.getCanvas().tabIndex=-1 and aria-hidden=true, or make the canvas the application surface and drop the wrapper stop; add to the keyboard-order acceptance test.

missed_by_specialist.title: role=toolbar proposed without its keyboard model
missed_by_specialist.evidence: Sections 6.2/13/15 put role=toolbar over 13 individually tabbable buttons; ARIA APG expects a single tab stop with arrow/Home/End navigation.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Implement roving tabindex + arrow keys, or omit the role and use a plain labelled group.

missed_by_specialist.title: Inline reduced-motion flag script conflicts with the enforced-CSP goal
missed_by_specialist.evidence: Finding 01 adds an inline <script> and finding 31 keeps it as one of only two remaining inline scripts; netlify.toml:19 report-only CSP allows scripts via 'unsafe-inline'; BRIEF A+ bar requires an enforced CSP.
missed_by_specialist.fix: Ship the flag as same-origin /a11y-flags.js so script-src 'self' needs no hash/nonce.

missed_by_specialist.title: Acceptance and CI gates rely on Lighthouse audits that cannot fail or move as stated
missed_by_specialist.evidence: lh_desktop.json/lh_mobile.json: bypass is scoreDisplayMode informative with score 1 and PASS title, landmark-one-main score 1; a11y weights label 10 + color-contrast 7 of 164, so 01 alone gives ~93.9 not >=97.
missed_by_specialist.fix: State in 8.2/8.3 that 100 requires 01+02-A; gate bypass/landmark checks with axe (region, page-has-heading-one) rather than Lighthouse assertions.
